subject: KA: SSPM/MCUPM DVFS design (README-0107-design.md), probe350mcu image, kernel 0110 (cache scope n2wm) + 0111 (IOConnectTrap6 ABI) + P13 images; run_all green
body: NUMBERING: 0107 = the CPU DVFS design note (doc only), 0108 = WAIT_SEQ(0) fix (async was never enabled), 0109 = MCUPM read-only probe, so cache scope = 0110, trap path = 0111. DVFS: stock Android 4.19 kernel disassembled (kallsyms+capstone): CPU DVFS is owned by MCUPM (0x10300000), not SSPM. AP side = copy static OPP table into CSRAM 0x11bc10.. (4 domains, 0x90 stride: LL 0x10, L 0xa0, B 0x130, CCI 0x1c0; row = MHz|volt<<16), IPI id 1 (4 words) cmd 0 {0,0} init table, cmd 10 init volts x4, cmd 1 {1,cpu_level}; then request = store OPP index at csram+0x37c+4*cluster (readback +0x354, min/max +0x320, cluster on/off +0x1224). This phone = level 1 = FY_30G26G (devinfo[7]&0xff==0x40): L 2600/1050mV..700/650, B 3000/1050..659/650, LL 2000/1000..500/650. LK leaves LL at the 1800 MHz row and L/B at ~728 MHz (=26x28, not in any table). Gate: is MCUPM firmware running (bootloader-loaded on reference SoCs, no loader in the kernel)? Unknown -> read-only probe image gpu/build/device-mmu-p12-candidate/probe350mcu (sha f518a4f5..., 593 chars, n2mcu=1: loads only from mcupm ctl regs 0x10300074/78/150/154, mailboxes 0x1031fce0+0xa0*n, SRAM head 0x10301000; risk = stall if the block is unclocked) - needs SEPARATE USER APPROVAL. Safety story (voltage firmware-owned from verbatim stock table, measure-verify-restore, min/max bound first, gauge guard, init IPIs irreversible so fallback = pin min=max) is in the README. 0110 (dfbf6177): n2wm=1 -> post-job invalidate only for buffers declared in write_mask (full=0 in all device windows, so the ~560 KiB/job is the scoped path: all listed CPU-visible GPU_WRITE client buffers; clean side NOT narrowed - needs CPU-write spans from the bridge). 0111 (cd87a185): kernel half of ledger #12, ABI byte-identical to nord2_transport.inc (120-byte block, 'N2TC'/'N2TD'), same externalMethod handler on the caller thread, reply memory proven writable BEFORE running so a refusal can never cause a double SUBMIT via MIG fallback. Images (P13 = cumulative 0100-0111 incl. the WAIT_SEQ fix 0108): ui654fb60 28819 7ef f (sha 288197ef..., 595 chars, n2fbhz=60) and ui654fb60wm a8994e7a... (602, + n2wm=1); earlier: P11 ui654fb60seq 7e3b06fb (WAIT_SEQ only). run_all.sh: 8 FINAL (incl. new nord2_trap_abi_test), 6 XNU, 2 MODEL PASS, 32/32 identical; 4 SNAPSHOT FAIL are the superseded pre-0088 transport original and core snapshots 0091/0096/0105 that assert the old WAIT_SEQ(0)=NotFound (= mutation check of 0108). render lead: trap probe in nord2_transport.inc needs no change; MAX_BO 256 in the bridge still caps handles.
